description: Template for a manually labeled retrieval benchmark. Copy this file and replace the placeholder values with labels from your own indexed corpus.

queries.query: Replace this with a real question from your corpus.
answer_patterns: key phrase the answer should contain
synonym or alternative wording that should also count
alternative wording you also want to count as correct
queries.notes: Page-level labels are usually the best starting point because they stay stable even if chunk boundaries change. answer_patterns are evaluated as any-of groups, where every concept inside a group must appear in the final answer. A nested list means any one of those alternative phrasings is acceptable for that concept.
